items.source: We only wanted to help the ogres, you know, and they seem more willing to cooperate now
items.target: 我们只是想帮助食人魔
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'We only wanted to help the ogres' - not 'the ogre you know'

items.source: though this should have made me strongly fear for my own safety
items.target: 尽管这本应让我强烈担心自身安危
items.bounded_fixed_context: fear for one's own safety, not 'strong fear for one's happiness'

items.source: I felt a strange sensation that coursed through every fiber of my being as the dwarf died by my own hand
items.target: 我感到一种奇怪的感觉，这种感觉随着矮人死于这一击而贯穿我的每一根纤维
items.bounded_fixed_context: old invented a 'wail passing through my body' not in source; corrected to the feeling of the dwarf's death passing through her

items.source: sparing you was my mistake
items.target: 放过我是我的错误
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'sparing you was my mistake' - not 'forgiving you was my mistake'

items.source: I struck the halfling in the back
items.target: 我立刻击中了半身人的后背
items.bounded_fixed_context: struck the halfling's back, not a vague 'counterattacked'

items.source: the ogre turning the spit
items.target: 负责转动烤肉叉的食人魔
items.bounded_fixed_context: the ogre was turning the roasting spit, not spitting

items.source: a cellar that had not been touched since the original shaloren residents had lived here
items.target: 自原先的永恒精灵居民居住于此以来一直未被触动
items.bounded_fixed_context: the cellar had been untouched since the original shaloren residents lived there

items.source: foolhardy witch
items.target: 鲁莽的女巫
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'foolhardy' = reckless, not 'brave'

items.source: also the worst conversationalist I have ever met
items.target: 也是我见过的最不会聊天的人
items.bounded_fixed_context: worst at conversation, a negative quality, not 'worst talker' misread as brave/positive

items.source: of the questions she posed to me
items.target: 在她提出的这些问题中
items.bounded_fixed_context: the questions were asked by the young mage (her), not the narrator (me)

items.source: I see you are doing alright, you're certainly quite tough thalore
items.target: 我看你恢复得不错，你确实很坚强
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'I see you are doing alright' is about physical recovery from injury, not general conduct

items.source: which only annoyed me, wishing she was further away
items.target: 希望她离我更远些
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'wished she was further away' - distance, not 'walk a bit more'

items.source: but you don't seem to have much combat experience
items.target: 而且你看起来也没什么战斗经验
items.bounded_fixed_context: the source only states Fay lacks combat experience, with no comparison to the witch

items.source: The words burst from my mouth before I could stop them
items.target: 这句话很快就从我口中脱口而出
items.bounded_fixed_context: the words burst out of her mouth, not 'vanished from her mind'

items.source: we perhaps led you to your own [imprisonment]
items.target: 我们获准解除监禁时，却可能把你带进了属于你的监禁之中
items.bounded_fixed_context: source (with a grammatical typo in the original) means the ogres, once freed, may have inadvertently led Fay into her own confinement (consistent with her being bedridden for months) - not 'bring you to your own place'

items.source: two officials of Elvala and a cadre of guards
items.target: 两名埃尔瓦拉的官员和一队卫兵
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'a cadre of guards' is plural, not 'a guard'

items.source: one of the bone giants stepped forward attempting to knock me down
items.target: 其中一个骨巨人走上前来，试图把我打倒
items.bounded_fixed_context: source subject is singular ('one of the bone giants'), old made it plural giants trampling

items.source: as I attacked it, this bone giant would also rearrange its bones
items.target: 在我攻击它的时候，这个骨巨人也会移动它的骨骼来强化自己
items.bounded_fixed_context: the bone giant is an undead construct, referred to as 'it', not 'she'

items.source: I slowly leaned in, kissing him again
items.target: 我慢慢俯身，再次亲吻他
items.bounded_fixed_context: leaning in to kiss, not crouching down

items.source: They possess no cultural identity or history to fall back on and sit on the precipice between the civilised races of Eyal's surface and the horrors of Eyal's underground.
items.target: 他们没有文化认同，也没有可供依凭的历史，处在埃亚尔地表的文明种族与地下的恐魔之间。
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'sit on the precipice between the civilised races of Eyal's surface and the horrors of Eyal's underground' - the Drem's own existential/categorical position, not their 'civilization's fate hanging' on a cliff

items.source: make there way towards the worms brain cluster and destroy it
items.target: 将某一个人传送到蠕虫的大脑里，然后摧毁它的脑簇
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'destroy it' refers to the worm's brain cluster specifically

items.source: Entropy is a chaotic force that seeks to spread more chaos throughout the universe.
items.target: 熵是混乱的能量，它总是在宇宙间不断制造更多的混乱。
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'Entropy' as an energy is singular ('it'), not plural

items.source: You have read a tome depicting the first teachings of entropy magic
items.target: 你阅读了一本描述了熵魔法最初教诲的古书
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'the first teachings of entropy magic' = teachings, not 'source'

items.source: Insanity is a measure of their own dementia and makes them more and more chaotic.
items.target: 疯狂值衡量着他们自身的痴狂程度，并使他们变得越来越混沌。
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'a measure of their own dementia' - specifically dementia, not vague 'psychological changes'

items.source: Long ago the mysterious machines that seem to be the source of dwarves malfunctioned
items.target: 那些似乎是矮人源头的神秘机器失灵了
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'the mysterious machines' is plural

items.source: Their wrath is so terrible they can stun their foes with any attacks
items.target: 他们的愤怒如此恐怖，任何攻击都能够震慑对手。
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'stun their foes with any attacks' = attacks, not 'any damage'

items.source: You have encountered the horror that came out of Kroltar, the mightiest wyrm, and vanquished it.
items.target: 你遇到了从最强大的巨龙库洛塔身上产生的恐魔，并击败了它。
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'the mightiest wyrm' = mightiest/strongest, not 'most terrifying'

items.source: Project slimy tentacles to pull your foes to you
items.target: 伸出黏滑的触手，将敌人拉向你
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'Project slimy tentacles to pull your foes to you' - dropped 'slimy' and changed 'pull to you' into a directionless 'grab'

items.source: Will crumble to dust when read!
items.target: 这本书会在阅读后化为尘土！
items.bounded_fixed_context: 'Will crumble to dust' = dust, not 'pieces/fragments'
